Messages.Author: Simon Klibisch
Messages.Body:
Hi!
I have two questions:

1. Are cards like Bone Spurs, Wolf Claws etc. played before strikes are
chosen or after choosing strikes?

2. The Errata for 2nd Tradition: Domain reads: "..., can be used to untap
and attempt to block..." does this mean the Vampire has to block or should
it read "may attempt to block" (in other words can you play redirection and
that sort of cards in combination with 2nd Tradition)?.

Thanks in advance,

Simon

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 10 Feb 2000, Simon Klibisch wrote:
> 1. Are cards like Bone Spurs, Wolf Claws etc. played before strikes are
> chosen or after choosing strikes?

They can be played in either BUT for them to count for this damage dealing
step, you have to play them after strikes are chosen but before damage is
resolved.

>
> 2. The Errata for 2nd Tradition: Domain reads: "..., can be used to untap
> and attempt to block..." does this mean the Vampire has to block or should
> it read "may attempt to block" (in other words can you play redirection and
> that sort of cards in combination with 2nd Tradition)?.

Errata:

Requires ready Prince or Justicar. +2 intercept. Also usable by a tapped
Prince or Justicar, even if intercept is not yet needed, to untap and
attempt to block with +2 intercept.

The vampire *has* to block - since they either need the intercept (first
case) or are compelled to block in the second case.

--

James Coupe

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Simon Klibisch wrote:
>
> Hi!
> I have two questions:
>

> 1. Are cards like Bone Spurs, Wolf Claws etc. played before strikes are
> chosen or after choosing strikes?

Either, so long as they are played before strike resolution begins.

> 2. The Errata for 2nd Tradition: Domain reads: "..., can be used to untap
> and attempt to block..." does this mean the Vampire has to block or should
> it read "may attempt to block" (in other words can you play redirection and
> that sort of cards in combination with 2nd Tradition)?.

The vampire has to attempt to block.
If the acting minion stealths by him, he is free to play deflection or
whatnot.
